test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The present value of an old car is Rs. 5,40,000. Its value depreciates at 25% per annum. What was its value (in Rs.) 2 years ago?
solution:
Given:

Present value = Rs. 5,40,000.

Its value depreciates at 25% per annum

Concept used:

Depreciated value = P(1 - R/100)n

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of depreciation

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let its value 2 years ago be Q.

According to the question,

Q (1 - 25/100)² = 540000

⇒ Q = 960000

**∴ its value 2 years ago was Rs. 9,60,000.**
